summary: Marked college car park among trees; north end is 40 m or more from homes.
reasons: Dwellings 16 m away only at south end
Trees and lawn all round the north end
Cars already parked in the bays

drivers.seclusion: North end backs onto trees and open grass; nearest dwelling is a house 16 m from the south edge, and the college buildings are 34 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park off College Road with marked bays; open bays visible and room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side car park off the loop road; low through traffic.
drivers.convention: Mapped car park with several cars parked; nobody would notice another vehicle.

flags: Mapped lift gate 7 m from the car park edge; mapped way round it
Likely college or university car park, so permits may apply
Brisbane River 300 m away, ground about 9 m elevation
sun_shade: Large trees shade the south and east sides; the north bays are open to sun.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is permit-only

best_section.where: north bays of the car park, near the road bend facing the river
